text:
I made fixes in six files, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because this session has no shell tool. I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests, so please run the suite yourself to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third title. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my guess, since the tests only check the titles.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
